Private note for you
She is not alone, and neither of them sounds faithful.
This message comes from a woman who thinks married women behave best when they stop pretending.
 
There is a reason this invitation feels louder than the usual note. Two women, shared mischief, and the kind of confidence that expects a man to walk straight toward it. 😈
Open the chat if you want to see how far that energy goes when someone finally answers properly.
That tension is there for a reason.
Step Into Trouble
We are both looking at you, Sophie 😉
